formulation_text.4: q_n = K_alpha,n c / U ;  K_q,n = (q_n - q_{n-1}) / dt  [1.7, 1.8]

formulation_text.6: X_1,n = X_1,n-1 exp(-b_1 beta^2 ds) + A_1 exp(-b_1 beta^2 ds/2) d(alpha_34)   [1.15]
formulation_text.7: X_2,n = X_2,n-1 exp(-b_2 beta^2 ds) + A_2 exp(-b_2 beta^2 ds/2) d(alpha_34)   [1.15]

formulation_text.14: K'_alpha,n = K'_alpha,n-1 exp(-dt/T_alpha) + (K_alpha,n - K_alpha,n-1) exp(-dt/(2 T_alpha))   [1.18]

formulation_text.26: D_p,n = D_p,n-1 exp(-ds/T_p) + (C_N^pot_n - C_N^pot_{n-1}) exp(-ds/(2 T_p))   [1.35]

formulation_text.29: f' = f(alpha_f ; M)          table look-up, section 4

formulation_text.39: 0 < tau_v <= T_VL:  C_N^v,n = C_N^v,n-1 exp(-ds/T_V) + (C_V,n - C_V,n-1) exp(-ds/(2 T_V))   [1.47]

formulation_text.43: C_C = eta C_N^c tan(alpha) sqrt f''                    [1.21, 1.32, with alpha for alpha_e + alpha_0]

formulation_text.45: C_L = C_N cos alpha + C_C sin alpha                    [1.2]
formulation_text.46: C_D = C_N sin alpha - C_C cos alpha + C_D0             [1.2]

formulation_text.49: C_M = C_M,s(alpha'_f ; M) + g (K_f C_M^c,q + C_M^nc,alpha + C_M^nc,q) - x_v C_N^v   [1.59]

formulation_text.54: steps per cycle = 2 pi / (k ds_max), rounded up to a multiple of 360 and at least 720,  ds_max = 0.02

formulation_text.56: W_i' = b_i beta^2 (alpha_34 - W_i),  i = 1, 2            X_i = A_i (alpha_34 - W_i)
formulation_text.57: W_5' = b_5 beta^2 (q - W_5)                              C_M^c,q = -(C_Nalpha/16)(q - A_5 (q - W_5))

formulation_text.59: Z_3' = (c/2U)(K_alpha - Z_3)/T_3 ,  Z_4' likewise with T_4 ,  Z_m' = (c/2U)(K_q - Z_m)/(k_mq^2 T_I)

formulation_text.62: alpha_m' = (alpha_f - alpha_m)/(c_m T_f0)                static moment read at alpha_m

formulation_text.63: C_N^v ' = -C_N^v/T_V + [vortex on chord] d/ds( C_N^c (1 - K_f) )
